We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic compound sample. No data given yet. We need to perform experiments: mass spec, NMR, IR etc. But we have no initial info. Perhaps the system expects us to first get mass spectrometry to get molecular weight, then deduce formula, then propose structure, then simulate spectra to compare.

We need to be resource-conscious. Start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and maybe isotopic pattern. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
